name: Test-time Pose Optimization
definition: A procedure to obtain camera poses for testing views by freezing the pre-trained 3DGS model and optimizing only the test view poses via photometric error minimization.
summary: Test-time Pose Optimization refines camera poses by freezing a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting model and minimizing photometric error, decoupling scene representation from camera parameters to improve novel view synthesis.
